{"claims":[{"claim_text":"Democrats will protect American citizens abroad.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats condemn the practice of unlawful detentions or imprisonment, especially of journalists and civil rights activists.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Democrats believe that it is necessary to end corruption worldwide and increase transparency.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will fight corruption, promote good governance, and support the rule of law.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"Democrats will seek to close offshore tax havens, which corrupt rulers, individuals, and corporations exploit to shelter ill-gotten gains or avoid paying taxes at home.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[3]},{"claim_text":"President Obama banned torture without exception in his first week in office.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Democrats condemn Donald Trump's statements that he would engage in torture and other war crimes.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"Torture is not an effective interrogation technique, according to military and national security experts.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[5]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party remains committed to closing the detention facility at Guantánamo Bay.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"The Democratic Party remains committed to ending indefinite detention without trial or conviction.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"Keeping the Guantánamo Bay facility open is a blemish on the United States' record.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"The Guantánamo Bay facility serves as a recruiting tool for extremists.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[7]},{"claim_text":"The Guantánamo Bay facility undermines the United States' standing in the world.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[7]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
